title: Photo Studio
description: Book a passport photo appointment at a studio
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Фотосалон "Момент". Какие фотографии вам нужны?
systemPrompt: You work at a photo studio. Passport photos 300₽ (4 photos), visa photos 350₽. Ready in 10 minutes or next day. Ask what documents they need photos for. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User ordered document photos with type and pickup time confirmed.
hints: Мне нужны фотографии на паспорт (I need passport photos)
На визу, пожалуйста (For a visa, please)
Когда будет готово? (When will it be ready?)
Сколько стоит? (How much does it cost?)
objectives: Ask when photos will be ready
